title: Chapter 758
text:
Black Star Corps Headquarters, Private Machinery Factory.

Dozens of Army Boxes were neatly stacked together, and hundreds of different models of mechanical soldiers were lined up in a row. From tall to short, from light to heavy, they were displayed before Han Xiao's eyes like an exhibition.

"Seventy percent of the soldier types haven't been changed. Part of the new blueprints came from Sardeem's accumulation, and they're basically all Giant Soldiers. The other part is new blueprints created through the fusion of knowledge. Although the knowledge hasn't been updated, as I became a Beyond Grade A, new blueprint combinations were unlocked. The experience I've accumulated during this period should be enough to gamble on blueprints …"

Looking at the models of the mechanical soldiers with his hands behind his back, Han Xiao pondered.

The update of the new army was mainly to create machines with better performance and reach the level of a Beyond Grade A Super. The innovation of the models was secondary.

Because of the lack of time, he did not have the means to learn the new knowledge. Therefore, most of the mechanical soldiers were still the old models, but their performance was much better than the previous generation of the army. With his increased Intelligence, [Mechanical Genius], and [Supreme Power], the upper limit of the performance of the mechanical soldiers was raised by a lot.

However, even if they were the old models, they were still the mechanical soldiers that Han Xiao had improved over the years. The designations of the ordinary armies were all restored, and the elite armies such as the Oathkeepers and Illusionists were also rebuilt. There were also many new units, such as the Giant Soldiers, the Star Destroyer Bombardment Group, the Black Knights, and so on. These were all new models of machinery.

In terms of large firepower weapons, Han Xiao had modified the Satellite Strike Weapon and other heavy cannons. Because he had yet to learn the relevant class knowledge, he had not been able to create a true Planet Destroyer Cannon. However, the modified Planet Destroyer Cannon's power was on par with the Ice Age Star Freezing Cannon, and its penetrative and explosive power were stronger. It could not directly blow up a planet, but it would not be a problem to blow up a small continent.

With firepower reaching the threshold of a Beyond Grade A, Han Xiao also built a new mechanical suit, replacing the original 'Mountain Ape'.

The new mecha was still mainly black in color. It was yellow and black and looked steady and heavy, like a ferocious beast that was growling. It had a rough and ferocious feel to it.

The armor was made of a very expensive and special alloy, and it was further strengthened with nano-deformation technology. It had a certain self-healing ability, and its shape was changeable, and its defense was superior. Its strength was movement. It was equipped with a quick jump device and could use instant jump multiple times in battle to attack or retreat. It was extremely mobile. In terms of firepower, other than the conventional energy weapons and melee weapons, it had also strengthened the output power of the psionic furnace.

The model of this mechanical suit was called 'Battle Tiger'. The original Mountain Ape was a piece of equipment suitable for level 165, but this' Battle Tiger 'was a level 215 orange equipment. Its performance was improved in all aspects. Its armor value was in the hundreds of thousands, and its power level was more than one. Before he obtained the Ultimate Knowledge to create his own trump card battle armor, Han Xiao would temporarily use this mechanical suit to deal with Beyond Grade A battles.

Among the supplementary abilities of the mechanical suit, there were many melee and charging abilities, mainly Crushing Strike, Pounce, and Grab. There was also a sonic attack named 'Tiger Roar', and so on. In terms of violence, it was above the Mountain Ape. Be it the power of the armor or the energy output, it was far higher than the Mountain Ape. It was a killing machine suitable for many battlefields.

"These machines have reached the Beyond Grade A combat level. As long as I stack them up, I will be able to fight normally." Han Xiao nodded.

These were the normal combat methods of a Beyond Grade A Mechanic. Some larger machines had not been built in time, such as Eternal Light and the new base. When he activated [Secondary Dimension Army], he would be able to break through the restrictions of the compressed orbs. Then, he would not only be able to bring an army with him, but he would also be able to bring along large machines such as satellite bases.

Boom!

At this moment, the room shook slightly.

"What's the situation?"

Han Xiao's eyes narrowed, and he contacted Philip.

"What happened?"

"Someone forcefully broke through the defense line of the headquarters and landed on the surface of the headquarters' satellite. I will now connect to the satellite image for you, hum …"

The next moment, Han Xiao's vision changed, and he connected to the headquarters' satellite. Looking down at the surface of the headquarters' satellite from high up in the sky, he saw a man breaking through the defense line of the fleet and landing heavily on the surface, causing the headquarters to sound the alarm. Countless army soldiers swarmed out like a tide and surrounded this person.

Seeing the appearance of this person, Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

"Hardaway?"

"Master, hum … your Black Star Guards have already rushed over. Do you want to deal with it personally?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and suddenly raised his hand. The Battle Tiger mechanical suit turned into a stream of black particles and climbed onto his arm, turning into a bracelet. He then opened the door of the workshop and walked out.

"Inform Hella. Don't let him escape. I'll be there immediately."

…

At the same time, around the Black Star Corps headquarters, hundreds of spaceships of various models were turning toward the headquarters and recording this scene with their cameras.

These spaceships were news spaceships from many galactic media outlets. In order to find out the true state of Black Star and obtain first-hand information, they had been loitering here for more than half a month. However, they were blocked by the Black Star Corps' defense fleet and could only stay nearby.

However, just a moment ago, a Calamity Grade Super appeared and forcefully broke through the defense line of the Black Star Corps headquarters, landing on the surface of the headquarters' satellite. This movement immediately attracted the attention of these galactic reporters, and everyone became alert.

It was rumored that Black Star had become a Beyond Grade A, and someone had actually come to provoke him. These reporters were shocked, but through their keen sense of smell, they realized that this was an opportunity to dig up big news, so they all gathered together to watch.

"I know this person. His name is Hardaway. He appeared in the secret war before and is from the Bloodshed Land."

"Could this be a provocation from the Bloodshed Land? Are they openly declaring war on the Black Star Corps? "

"There's going to be a good show!"

At the entrance of the headquarters' satellite, the army soldiers had already surrounded Hardaway, and countless cannons were aimed at him. However, Hardaway did not panic, patting his clothes and speaking loudly.

"I'm here to find your Army Commander. Your fleet won't let me in, so I can only force my way in."

Because Han Xiao had given the order before he went into seclusion, he would not accept any visitors for the time being. These chores were all handed over to Sylvia and Herlous, and the defense fleet faithfully carried out this order. Even though Hardaway had announced his name, he did not receive any special treatment, so he had forced his way in. This was intentional.

This time, a red light shot over from afar and landed in front of Hardaway. It was Hella.

"Don't move." Hella's face was cold, and her aura was overflowing with red light, attracting everyone's attention.

Hardaway stopped in his tracks, sizing up Hella seriously. "Who are you?"

"Black Star's Black Star Guards captain, Hella!"

"Black Star Guards?"

Hardaway's eyes sparkled.
